name: Brocéliande
text: Brocéliande is an Arthurian forest in eastern Brittany. People believe the magician Merlin rests inside it. His mistress Viviane imprisoned him in the wood. She wanted to trick his magical knowledge from him. Legend says he lives forever within a great tree. A cold fountain called Baranton also stands there. Its guardian lady can call up storms at her bidding. The forest lies near the town of Rennes. Today people call it the Forest of Paimpont. It may be the last remaining nemeton in Europe.
